# Ecclesiastes Chapter 10 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**10:1** Flies [zevuvei] of-death [mavet] cause-to-stink [yav'ish] [and] ferment [yabbia] the-oil [shemen] of-the-perfumer [roqe'ach]; weightier [yaqar] than-wisdom [me-chokhmah] [and] than-honor [mi-kavod] [is] a-little [me'at] folly [sikhlut].

**10:2** The-heart [lev] of-the-wise [chakham] [is] at-his-right [li-mino], and-the-heart [ve-lev] of-the-fool [kesil] [is] at-his-left [li-smolo].

**10:3** And-also on-the-way [ba-derekh], when-the-fool [she-ha-sakhal] walks [holekh], his-heart [libbo] is-lacking [chaser], and-he-says [ve-amar] to-all [la-kol] that-he [she-hu] [is] a-fool [sakhal hu].

**10:4** If the-spirit [ruach] of-the-ruler [ha-moshel] rises [ta'aleh] against-you [alekha], your-place [meqomekha] do-not-leave [al tannach]; for calmness [marpe] sets-aside [yanniach] great [gedolim] offenses [chata'im].

**10:5** There-is [yesh] an-evil [ra'ah] I-saw [ra'iti] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh], like-an-error [ki-shegagah] that-goes-out [she-yotze] from-before [mi-lifnei] the-ruler [ha-shallit]:

**10:6** Folly [ha-sekhel] is-set [nittan] in-great [be-meromim rabbim] heights, and-the-rich [va-ashirim] in-lowness [ba-shefel] sit [yeshevu].

**10:7** I-saw [ra'iti] servants [avadim] on horses [al susim], and-princes [ve-sarim] walking [holkhim] like-servants [ka-avadim] on the-earth [al ha-aretz].

**10:8** The-one-who-digs [chofer] a-pit [gummatz] will-fall [yippol] into-it [bo], and-the-one-who-breaks-through [u-foretze] a-wall [gader] a-serpent [nachash] will-bite-him [yishshekhennu].

**10:9** The-one-who-quarries [massi'a] stones [avanim] will-be-hurt [ye'atzev] by-them [bahem]; the-one-who-splits [boke'a] logs [etzim] will-be-endangered [yissakken] by-them [bam].

**10:10** If the-iron [ha-barzel] is-blunt [qehah], and-he [ve-hu] does-not [lo] sharpen [qilqal] [its] face [panim], then-he-must-increase [ve-chayalim yegabber] [his] strength [ve-yitron]; and-the-advantage [ve-yitron] of-making-succeed [hakhsher] [is] wisdom [chokhmah].

**10:11** If the-serpent [ha-nachash] bites [yishokh] without [be-lo] enchantment [lachash], then-there-is-no [ve-ein] advantage [yitron] to-the-master [le-ba'al] of-the-tongue [ha-lashon].

**10:12** The-words [divrei] of-the-mouth [pi] of-a-wise-man [chakham] [are] gracious [chen], but-the-lips [ve-siftot] of-a-fool [kesil] swallow-him [tevall'ennu].

**10:13** The-beginning [techillat] of-the-words [divrei] of-his-mouth [pihu] [is] folly [sikhlut], and-the-end [ve-acharit] of-his-mouth [pihu] [is] evil [ra'ah] madness [holelut].

**10:14** And-the-fool [ve-ha-sakhal] multiplies [yarbeh] words [devarim]; the-human [ha-adam] does-not-know [lo yeda] what-will-be [mah she-yihyeh], and-what [u-mah] will-be [she-yihyeh] after-him [me-acharav] who can-tell-him [mi yaggid lo]?

**10:15** The-toil [amal] of-fools [ha-kesilim] wearies-them [teyagg'ennu], [for] he-does-not-know [asher lo yada] to-go [la-lekhet] to the-city [el ir].

**10:16** Woe-to-you [i lakh], O-land [eretz], whose-king [she-malkekh] [is] a-boy [na'ar], and-your-princes [ve-sarayikh] eat [yokhelu] in-the-morning [ba-boqer].

**10:17** Happy-are-you [ashrekh], O-land [eretz], whose-king [she-malkekh] [is] a-son [ben] of-nobles [chorim], and-your-princes [ve-sarayikh] eat [yokhelu] in-the-proper-time [ba-et], for-strength [bi-gevurah] and-not [ve-lo] for-drinking [ba-sheti].

**10:18** By-much-laziness [ba-atzaltayim] the-roof-beam [ha-meqareh] sags [yimmakh], and-by-drooping [u-ve-shiflut] of-hands [yadayim] the-house [ha-bayit] drips [yidlof].

**10:19** For-laughter [li-sechoq] they-make [osim] bread [lechem], and-wine [ve-yayin] gladdens [yesamach] life [chayyim], and-money [ve-ha-kesef] answers [ya'aneh] everything [et ha-kol].

**10:20** Even [gam] in-your-thought [be-madda'akha] do-not-curse [al teqallel] the-king [melekh], and-in-your-bed-chambers [u-ve-chadrei mishkavekha] do-not-curse [al teqallel] the-rich [ashir]; for a-bird [of] of the-heavens [ha-shamayim] will-carry [yolikh] the-sound [et ha-qol], and-a-winged-one [u-va'al ha-kenafayim] will-tell [yaggid] the-matter [davar].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "flies of death":** The Hebrew *zevuvei mavet* (death-flies) may be connected to *Ba'al Zevuv* ("Lord of the Flies"), the deity of Ekron (2 Kings 1:2). The image: even something small and contemptible can ruin something valuable.

**v.10 — Difficult syntax:** This verse is notoriously difficult in Hebrew. The general sense is clear — a dull tool requires more effort, but wisdom (like sharpening) gives advantage — but the exact parsing is debated.

**v.19 — "money answers everything":** Hebrew *ha-kesef ya'aneh et ha-kol*. This may be ironic wisdom — Qoheleth observing what the world believes rather than endorsing it.

*-- EMET*
